title: Temple Theme Kit inner pages, group D: Shop as a TempleKitInner block and page
detail: One block type (TempleKitInnerShop, drawn through the shared kind-tab board components/sites/temple-kit-inner/shelf-board.tsx), its rules in the group B sheet (inner-b-css.ts, tokens only) and the page builder in components/sites/temple-kit-inner/pages-d.ts for the design's Shop page. Names, kinds and prices are typed by the Space; no rating, review count or stock number is seeded. Registration (block map, sheet, pages) belongs to the Temple kit registration pass. Book follows under LIVE-1689.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("components/page-editor/blocks/temple-kit-inner-d.tsx","utf8");if(!t.includes("TempleKitInnerShop:")){console.error("the Temple Kit Shop block is missing");process.exit(1)}'
